Top-cited AI scientists at four US companies (Top 2% List 2026)

## What it shows

Four panels, one each for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Meta. Each dot is one of the company’s listed authors in the US whose main subfield is Artificial Intelligence & Image Processing. Across is the number of papers they have published in all years. Up is the citations their work got in 2025. The grey behind is every one of the 2,531 US listed authors in AI.

The typical author at Anthropic got 4,830 citations in 2025, at OpenAI 2,150, at Google 1,481 and at Meta 1,295. The typical US AI author got 968, with 88 papers. At each of the four companies the typical author has at most half as many papers, from 34 to 44, and more citations.

Anthropic has 9 listed authors in AI in the US, OpenAI 18, Google 169 and Meta 122.

## How it was made

A company counts every name the list gives it. Google includes Google DeepMind. Alphabet’s other companies, such as Waymo and Verily, are left out. Only authors in the United States are counted.
